name: Barcode verified — AI Product Match Verification
description: “Barcode verified” is an open specification, version 0.1, formally titled “AI Product Match Verification”. It defines what a verified product match is, what evidence it rests on, and what a receipt for one must carry. Any artificial intelligence (AI), retailer or brand may implement it; the words “Barcode verified” are free to any conforming implementation. It answers one question for an AI agent at the moment of purchase: is the product the shopper asked for, the product the merchant is offering, and the product on the verified record, all the same barcode — and how does the agent prove it checked.
